implementation_boundary: Executable-generated observations only. Original engine implementation source and ports were withheld. Compiled SOL runtime data is distributed separately in data/ with corresponding authoring assets and original notices.
raw_key_method: Independent Rust state starts from compiled SOL initial state and receives delivered raw arrow keys. Reference NBR states are compared, never injected. Fixed90Hz simulation under deterministic60Hz SDL frame clock; camera3 selected before arrow input. These are bounded short routes, not full course completion recordings.
orientation_method: Two1123-update runs feed recorded tilt/basis and collision-step timing to an independently evolving ball; compare outer and inner orientation against recorded bases. This is a component comparison, not raw-key end-to-end coverage.
component_method: Numerical measurements from direct calls to original executable functions using caller-owned synthetic structures: six collision cases, ten path samples, five jump predicates, three90-update core trajectories and eight item transitions. Timer fixture covers two shared fractional-millisecond schedules; path-budget fixture covers6ms paths within a100ms update. No decompiler text or debugger internals are included.
